The European is a quarterly business publication, published by Chase Publishing in London. It is available in hard copy, and digital format and is accessible at various trade fairs worldwide.

feeds.title: Frankfurt School » Executive Education
feeds.description: At Frankfurt School, we offer premium Executive Education Programmes for executives and companies. Frankfurt School of Finance & Management (FS) is a research-led private business school accredited by EQUIS, AMBA, and AACSB. Frankfurt School specializes in finance, economics, and management and offers Bachelor, Master, MBA, and doctoral programs as well as executive education courses and seminars for working professionals and trainees.

feeds.title: HEC Executive Education Blog
feeds.description: HEC Liège Executive Education offers continuing education in management to top managers, middle managers, entrepreneurs, freelancers, and employees who seek to develop or develop their employees in their professional activity. These training courses are adapted to these demanding audiences: they provide specific and rigorous information, a vision of the future, operational know-how, meetings with other professionals, and expert answers to concrete questions encountered in the field.

feeds.description: Find resources for executive training, growth, and development.

feeds.title: Silicon Valley Executive Education Blog
feeds.description: At Silicon Valley Executive Education (SVEE), we believe in meeting your learning needs for the long term. Our consultants work alongside you to drive outcomes through customized programs for ongoing employee education. We're committed to preparing teams for the short term while enhancing operations in the long run. And, with the help of our top-tier roster of experienced faculty consultants, we'll help you face your most immediate concerns.

feeds.title: TUM Asia
feeds.description: Since 2002, TUM Asia has been running joint Master Programmes conferred by TUM, with NTU and NUS, such as MSc in Industrial Chemistry; MSc in Integrated Circuit Design; MSc in Green Electronics; MSc in Aerospace Engineering; an MSc in Rail, Transport, and Logistics. Lecturers and professors hail from as far as Germany and their wealth of knowledge from various fields provides a spectrum of experience for the students to glean from.

feeds.title: Northwest Executive Education Blog
feeds.description: Northwest Education operates in executive education, continuous learning, and corporate learning domain focusing on adult learners across the world. We have an extensive portfolio of comprehensive modular programs for executives in collaboration with some of the world's best universities.

feeds.title: CEOWORLD magazine

The CEOWORLD magazine is the world's leading business magazine for CEOs, CFOs, high-level executive professionals, business leaders, and high-net-worth individuals. With more than 12.4+ million page views, CEOWORLD magazine is the world's leading business magazine written strictly for CEOs, CFOs, CIOs, senior management executives, business leaders, and high-net-worth individuals worldwide.

feeds.title: QUTeX Blog
feeds.description: QUTeX is a flexible learning paradigm helping individuals and organisations get future fit through specialised Open Courses, Professional Development and Executive Education. This unique, progressive approach enables learners to extend existing skills, learn new skills, become more adaptable, more multi-disciplined and more valuable in the future.
